text_block_list.text:
—Spring of the Classic Year was fast 
approaching. Having accumulated a wealth 
of experience, Hishi Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Man, I feel like I'm finally starting to 
look like a professional Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And when entering the training grounds, 
she stopped saying, "Heeey, excuse 
meee..."

"She's gotten moderately tougher. 
However..."
choice_data_list:
It's almost time for the Classic Triple 
Crown season.

It's almost time for the Classic Triple 
Crown season.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah~, now that you mention it~, maybe 
that's true...

—The Classic Triple Crown. The spring 
Satsuki Sho and Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), followed by the autumn Kikuka Sho 
for Classic-tier racers.

Those three GⅠ races are collectively 
called by that name. Many Umamusume give 
it their all, aiming for this series of 
races.
choice_data_list: If that's what Hishi Miracle wishes for...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Wish for it?! Me?! No way, no way, no 
way...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is where 
Umamusume who bet everything on racing 
gather, right~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Going all out against girls like that 
feels a bit... awkward. Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not a shred of fighting spirit ever 
emerged. There was no sign of the drive to 
beat the strong rivals of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I had no choice but to force 
her fighting spirit awake. I decided to 
take action.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, uphill training is changed to this 
time starting today, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you set aside time for me 
when you were free? If so, then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eek, what!????

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Someone kicked through the fence and came 
over here? That's—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Who goes there... Who dares interrupt the 
moment of my pact, my metamorphosis from 
"me" into "myself"?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If you've wandered into the arena, you'd 
best seize both the spotlight and the 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet... chan?! Are we wearing 
the exact same thing~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――I've decided to administer some "potent 
medicine." Yes, Tanino Gimlet is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fellow Umamusume of the same generation 
who fully earns the moniker "God of 
Destruction." She is a prime contender for 
the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I intentionally aligned their track usage 
times to encourage them to compete against 
each other.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Wanna roar with me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, so very, very, very much...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, returning to the mortal realm? Then 
go. I have already destroyed the rift.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Go back...? You mean, stop training?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: “If I did that, though, Trainer would...”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(She'd be sad... wouldn't she. That would 
be just like before, making excuses to 
slack off...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I have to... I have to do something. Even 
if it's a little scary...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Gimlet... chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... well, you see, I'd like to train 
here too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So... that's why. If you'd like...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—if you'd like... what?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fire has been lit. In that Hishi 
Miracle, no less. Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Competing against one another is the 
destiny of an Umamusume. If there is only 
one track, the only option is to run side 
by side—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you want, maybe we could take turns 
running! Or something like that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nono, don't worry. I'll make sure to 
watch Gimlet-chan finish running before I 
head onto the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It didn't catch fire... What exploded 
instead was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—“Survival instinct.” The sheer 
adaptability of someone who’s quietly 
survived in the corner of the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle excelled in the art of 
coexisting peacefully without drawing the 
ire of those at the top of the school 
caste.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Taking turns? Waiting until 
they finish running before entering the 
course... you say?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No need for consideration! Once I'm done 
running, I'll give you a signal. Come in 
when you hear it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Yay, sorry for making you go out 
of your way~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tanino Gimlet was surprisingly 
cooperative. No fighting or running 
side-by-side occurred at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, for several days, they went 
through completely separate training 
menus, but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Gimlet-chan is amazing. Her running is so 
breathtakingly powerful...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I think I want to see it up close! Even 
if we don't run side-by-side, if we just 
enter the course together...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(To do that, we need to get along a little 
better~...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me, Gimlet-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Your running is incredible. Is it because 
your passion for the Classic Triple Crown 
burns so bright that you can run like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: K-Kekeke—one of the two rivers, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, one of the... AnFes events?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, there are two rivers. The Classic 
Triple Crown is the 'River of Fire.' And 
the other is—”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The "River of the Underworld" that cuts 
through the mile.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The mile...? Ah~ Wait, do you mean the NHK 
Mile Cup?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if there are two— "I" shall unite the 
twin currents and reach the vast ocean. 
Indeed, what I embrace in both these arms 
is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Both!! Conquering the Satsuki Sho and the 
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), as well as 
the NHK Mile Cup in between!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is the forbidden 'MC Rotation'!! 
Hwahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehk, no way...!? Both of them... 
eeeeeh...~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The 'MC Rotation.' What came out of her 
mouth was an outrageous ambition."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An ultra-aggressive campaign to run in the 
Satsuki Sho in April, and both the NHK 
Mile Cup and Japan Derby in May...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an unusually packed rotation that 
one would normally never aim for...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I... see... So aiming for something 
like that is why she runs so amazingly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry~. Without knowing that, I 
went and talked to you, interrupting your 
training~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, since you're cheering for 
me~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Hishi Miracle rushed over to 
me—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Girls with a strong sense of 
self really are something else, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought there was no way I could ever 
reach it, but now I understand why.
choice_data_list: It might just reach them, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I mean, it's the "Mile 
Championship rotation," right? Calling it 
amazing is an understatement—it's 
downright insane.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I think I'll just keep doing things my 
own way..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely picked the wrong person to 
challenge. An ordinary dream would be one 
thing, but hers is just too massive..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems better to look for a way to 
ignite her fighting spirit from a 
different angle.
